# A new invocation can look up a projection's saved workspace by name.

# Use a known workspace path so the lookup has an independent expectation.
mkdir definition/layers
mv give/layer definition/layers/0001-base
cd definition
git init -q -b main
exec layerctl projection create demo --worktree $WORK/workspace

exec layerctl projection path demo
cmpenv stdout $WORK/want/path

-- give/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = "Start projection"
-- want/path --
$WORK/workspace
